```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman"); library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse)
pacman::p_load(ggpubr)
# install.packages("knitr")
if (!dir.exists("figures")) {dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)}
if (!dir.exists("figures/crop_kc_curves")) {dir.create("figures/crop_kc_curves", showWarnings = FALSE)}
if (!dir.exists("figures/water_budgets")) {dir.create("figures/water_budgets", showWarnings = FALSE)}
if (!dir.exists("data")) {dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)}
if (!dir.exists("data/water_budgets")) {dir.create("data/water_budgets", showWarnings = FALSE)}
```

## Load Data & Functions

```{r load_data_&_functions}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Get Required Input Data ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
rain <- read.csv(file = "data-raw/rainfall.csv", header = TRUE) # Provide date in a standard unambiguous format: YYYY-MM-DD
et0.week.imd <- read.csv(file = paste0("data/et0.week.imd.csv"), header = TRUE) # year, week (0-52), et0
et0.daily <- read.csv(file = "data-raw/et0.csv", header = TRUE) # Provide date in a standard unambiguous format: YYYY-MM-DD

# The following are prepared with 
# code:
# source("code/01_format_crop_kc_crop_param_&_soil_param.R")
# and data files:
# 1. "data-raw/Kc Billikere final_mod.xlsx", sheet = "Crop cycles Kc"
# 2. "data-raw/Model Crop Rotations Water budget Billikere_estimated rotations_effective rainfall.xlsx", sheet = "CROP paprameter"

crop.param <- read.csv(file = "data/crop.parameters.csv", header = TRUE)
kc.doy.crops <- read.csv(file = "data/Kc_curve_parameters_by_crop_rotation.csv", header = TRUE)
soil.param <- read.csv(file = "data/soil.parameters.csv", header = TRUE)

#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Source Functions ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
source("code/02_function_get_Peff.R")
source("code/03_function_get_et0.R")
source("code/04_function_get_kc.R")
source("code/05_function_get_budget.R")
```

## User sets Parameters here for Water Budget functions

```{r set_param_budget}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Provide Input Parameters ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Crop System ---- 
rotations <- kc.doy.crops %>% select(rotation, crop, crop.rotation) %>% unique() %>%
  # Adding no_crop 
  bind_rows(data.frame(rotation = -1, crop = "no_crop", crop.rotation ="no_crop_-1")) %>%
  arrange(rotation)
crop.system.ls <- split(rotations, rotations$rotation)
save(crop.system.ls, file = "data/crop.system.ls.Rdata")
# > crop.system.ls[1]
# $`-1`
#   rotation    crop crop.rotation
# 1       -1 no_crop    no_crop_-1

crop.system <- rotations %>% select(-crop.rotation) %>%
  group_by(rotation) %>%
  mutate(number = 1:n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = number, names_glue = "crop_{number}", values_from = crop)
write.csv(crop.system, file = "data/crop.system.csv", row.names = FALSE)
#    rotation crop_1         crop_2    crop_3     
#       <dbl> <chr>          <chr>     <chr>      
#  1       -1 no_crop        NA        NA         
#  2        0 formule        NA        NA         
#  3        1 BlackEyedBeans millet    NA         
#  4        2 BlackEyedBeans HorseGram NA         
#  5        3 FieldBeans     Horsegram NA         
#  6        4 millet         NA        NA         
#  7        5 Maize          NA        NA         
#  8        6 FieldBeans     NA        NA         
#  9        7 Ginger         NA        NA         
# 10        8 FingerMillet   Maize     NA         
# 11        9 Coconut        NA        NA         
# 12       10 Cabbage        Tomato    NA         
# 13       11 Cabbage        Cucumber  Tomato_Irri
# 14       12 Cabbage        Rice      NA         
# 15       13 Cabbage        Maize     NA         
# 16       14 Horsegram      Maize     NA         
# 17       15 Banana         NA        NA         
# 18       16 Areca          NA        NA         
# 19       17 Cabbage        Coconut   beans_Irri 
p.list <- list(rain = rain,
               crop.param = crop.param,
               soil.param = soil.param,
               # et0.timestep = "weekly", # weekly/daily
               # et0.input = et0.week.imd, # For "weekly", choose: et0.week.imd
               et0.timestep = "daily", # weekly/daily
               et0.input = et0.daily, # For "daily", choose: et0.daily
               kc.doy.crops = kc.doy.crops,
               kc_no_crop = list(summer = 0.005, kr = 0.2),
               soil.type = "red",
               CN = 85,
               sm.init = 0.5)
```

## Run water budget functions

```{r get_budget, eval = TRUE}
met.forcing <- get_peff_et0(p = p.list)
# Provide crop.system.ls or sub elements like crop.system.ls[c(1, 3)]
budget <- lapply(crop.system.ls, get_budget, p = p.list, ts = met.forcing)
save(budget, file = "data/water_budgets/Budget.Rdata")
# For debugging:
# cs <- crop.system.ls[[13]]
# for (i in 1:length(crop.system.ls)) {
#   budget <- lapply(crop.system.ls[i], get_budget, p = p.list, ts = met.forcing)
# }
```
## Output Plots

### Crop System Summary

```{r plot-summary, echo = TRUE, fig.align = 'center', fig.cap = '...'}

load(file = "data/water_budgets/Budget.Rdata")
crop.system <- read.csv(file = "data/crop.system.csv", header = TRUE)
summary.yr.ls <- lapply(budget, function(x) {return(x$summary.yr)})
# summary.crop.ls <- lapply(summary.yr.ls, bind_rows, .id = "rotation")
summary.crop <- do.call(rbind, summary.yr.ls) 
summary.crop$rownames <- rownames(summary.crop)
summary.crop <- summary.crop %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(rownames, ".", names = c("rotation", "extra"), cols_remove = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(rotation = as.numeric(rotation)) %>% 
  select(-extra) %>%
  left_join(crop.system, by = "rotation") %>%
  mutate(crop_2 = if_else(is.na(crop_2), "", crop_2),
         crop_3 = if_else(is.na(crop_3), "", crop_3),
         crop.system = paste(crop_1, crop_2, crop_3, sep = " "))

summ.qs <- summary.crop %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = quantile, values_from = value) %>%
  arrange(var, `0.5`) #%>% 
  # group_by(var) %>%
  # mutate(group.col = if_else(`0.5` < mean(`0.5`, na.rm = TRUE), "Low", "High")) %>%
  # ungroup()

# arrange factor levels in the order of 'balance' 
summ.qs.balance <- summ.qs %>% subset(var %in% c("balance")) %>%
  arrange(`0.5`) %>% 
  mutate(crop.system = factor(crop.system, crop.system)) # this line reorders the factor in the same order
summ.qs$crop.system <- factor(summ.qs$crop.system,
                              levels=levels(summ.qs.balance$crop.system))
save(summ.qs, file = "data/water_budgets/summ.qs.Rdata")

p.crop.sys.summ <- ggplot(summ.qs %>% 
                            subset(var %in% c("balance", "irrigation", "aet.to.Peff", "aet.to.etc.crop")),
       aes(y = crop.system, x = `0.5`)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ var, scales = "free_x") +
  geom_col() + xlab("Median (SE)") + ylab("Crop System") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmax = `0.975`, xmin = `0.025`), width = 0.1) +
  theme_classic()
print(p.crop.sys.summ)
ggsave(plot = p.crop.sys.summ, file = paste0("figures/water_budgets/crop.system_budget_summary.pdf"),
        width = 9, height = 4)
```
